brief.text: Closed-End Funds represent a distinct trend in today's cluster activity, with BPRE, PSUS, and SWZ combining for over $31.5 million across multiple buyers. Borr Drilling (BORR) logged the single largest cluster value at $43.9 million among three insiders, while Pampa Energy (PAM) also recorded a substantial $16.4 million total. Accelevation Holdings (ACCV) stands out for broad participation with an unusual five insiders acquiring $4.1 million, and Ryan Cohen generated the largest single transaction of the day with a $22.8 million commitment to GME.
